description: cmux.widget/1 records (record.schema.json plus the byte caps in limits.json). acpmux writes only valid records; every reader (pane, Swift host, iOS) drops invalid ones. error: schema = the JSON Schema rejects it; too_large = it matches the schema but breaks a byte cap. A value {"$fill": {"text": T, "count": N}} anywhere in a vector stands for the string T repeated N times; expand it before validation.
